text:
maya_marketing: ok team — quick sync on the launch playbook for the webinar + three launch posts. We need: keyword mapping, FAQ/schema for the webinar page, internal link plan, redirects for legacy urls, and inbound lead routing to SFDC. Who owns what?

sam_seo: I can own keyword mapping + intent notes + canonical recommendations. Will pull SERP snippets and suggested CTAs.

jordan_pm: I'll take FAQ schema + event markup for the webinar page. If you give me the rough Qs I can turn them into JSON-LD.

lee_eng: I'll own redirects and the server snippet. Want to confirm redirect list before we push. Also can stage redirects behind a feature flag for a soft roll.

anya_growth: I'll handle GTM event wiring and SFDC lead routing. Need to know hidden form fields and utm rules we'll use.

maya_marketing: timeline: drafts of posts by Mon EOD, webinar page Wednesday 4pm PT, prefer redirects staged by Wed 3pm PT. Can we hit that?

sam_seo: +1. I'll deliver a sheet with primary/secondary keywords, target URL, target anchor text, and suggested H1/H2 by Mon EOD. I'll also mark which pages should get FAQ schema vs article schema.

jordan_pm: sample FAQ schema we can reuse (I'll paste final after review):

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What will the webinar cover?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "A 45-minute walkthrough of inference cost optimizations, followed by a live demo and Q&A."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Who should attend?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Engineers and ML/Platform leads responsible for model serving and inference economics."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

lee_eng: nginx redirect example I'm planning to use (we'll template):

```nginx
# redirect old blog slugs to new content hub
location ~ ^/old-blog/(.*)$ {
  return 301 https://redwood.ai/content/$1;
}

# explicit 301s for renamed posts
rewrite ^/posts/2020/model-serving$ /content/model-serving-ops permanent;
```

anya_growth: lead routing play: utm_campaign=webinar_q3 + hidden form field source=webinar -> SFDC queue = "webinar-nurture". GA4 event 'webinar_register' on submit, and trigger campaign attribution. I'll create the GTM tag and SFDC flow.

maya_marketing: internal linking quick wins: add contextual CTAs from product pages to each post, add a persistent top-banner on product pages for registration, and add 'related posts' module that points back to the hub. Sam — can you produce the anchor list?

sam_seo: yup. Also recommend rel=canonical on any syndicated copies + meta robots for low-value paginated archives. I'll flag potential cannibalization.

jordan_pm: small content note — include a 1–paragraph summary for each post that can be used as og:description and schema 'description' to improve SERP snippets.

lee_eng: one question — do we need to preserve any old query params for tracking? If yes, we can map them and do 302s first so GA doesn't break, then flip to 301 after 7 days.

anya_growth: good call. There's an old param ?ref=partners we still want to keep. I'll make a mapping table and pass to you. Also we'll add an event to capture original_ref in the lead record.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: redirects config will be staged in /staging at 2025-07-21T14:00:00Z. PR link will be posted in the channel once open.

maya_marketing: perfect. action owners: sam -> keyword + anchor list; jordan -> FAQ schema draft + og snippets; lee -> redirect PR + staging; anya -> GTM + SFDC flow. Check-in tomorrow 9am PT. :rocket: 

sam_seo: added to my board and calendar, will attach the sheet Monday.

jordan_pm: will paste final JSON-LD into the content doc and ping for review.

lee_eng: will open the redirect PR and add tests for query param mapping.

anya_growth: I'll create the SFDC queue and share the routing doc (including hidden fields).

maya_marketing: thanks everyone — one more quick win: add structured data for 'Event' on the webinar page so we get rich results. Jordan — can you include that with the FAQ schema?

jordan_pm: yes, will combine Event + FAQ in a single JSON-LD block and drop into the content template.

maya_marketing: ok closing thread for now. we'll reconvene tomorrow. :calendar:
